Agent Name: Corporate_Governance_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The first mistaken conclusion appears when the Corporate_Governance_Expert says that all listed members had held C-suite positions and implies there may be no qualifying board member. This is too broad and not properly verified. The actual Apple board member among the listed names who did **not** hold a traditional C-suite role before joining the board is **Susan L. Wagner**: she was BlackRock’s co-founder, Vice Chairman, and COO, but not CEO. The error came from treating every senior executive title as a C-suite position and from failing to distinguish between C-suite roles and other top leadership roles.
